messages.content: What are the components of Civil Law?

function.name: file_complaint

message.content:
Civil law is a broad legal system that governs non-criminal disputes between private parties. Its main components include: | Component | Purpose | Key Elements | |-----------|---------|--------------| | **Legal Sources** | Provide the authority and content of civil law. | • Statutes & legislation (primary source)
• Case law / judicial decisions (secondary source)
• Administrative regulations
• International treaties (when applicable) | | **Civil Procedure** | Regulates how civil cases are brought, processed, and resolved. | • Pleadings & claims
• Discovery & evidence rules
• Trial & hearing procedures
• Appeals & post‑judgment enforcement | | **Substantive Civil Law** | Defines rights, duties, and liabilities of parties. | • Contract law
• Tort law
• Property law
• Family law
• Succession & estate law | | **Remedies & Relief** | Determines what courts can award to resolve disputes. | • Damages (compensatory, punitive, nominal)
• Injunctions & specific performance
• Rescission & reformation of contracts | | **Jurisdiction & Venue** | Establishes which court has authority over a case. | • Personal jurisdiction (over parties)
• Subject‑matter jurisdiction (over the dispute)
• Venue rules (where the case should be heard) | | **Evidence Rules** | Governs admissibility and weight of evidence. | • Relevance, authenticity, hearsay exceptions
• Expert testimony
• Documentary & testimonial evidence | | **Specialized Areas** | Address specific types of disputes or parties. | • Consumer protection
• Employment law
• Intellectual property
• Environmental law
• Construction & engineering disputes | | **Enforcement Mechanisms** | Ensure compliance with judgments and orders. | • Court orders & writs
• Asset seizure & garnishment
• Mediation & arbitration enforcement | | **Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR)** | Provides non‑court methods to resolve disputes. | • Negotiation
• Mediation
• Arbitration
• Conciliation | | **Legal Ethics & Professional Responsibility** | Sets standards for lawyers and judges. | • Confidentiality
• Conflict‑of‑interest rules
• Duty of competence & diligence | These components work together to create a comprehensive framework that protects individual rights, resolves disputes fairly, and maintains social order within a civil law system.
